headline: Chinese Tech Firms Prepare AI Plans for Stricter US Semiconductor Controls
summary: Technology companies in China are adjusting artificial intelligence roadmaps as the US government prepares tighter restrictions on advanced chip exports to the country.
why: US semiconductor restrictions aim to limit China's access to high-performance AI chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Tighter export controls impede Chinese tech companies' capabilities to train advanced AI models.
